series.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash | MI355X / SGLang | 2026-10-15 historical AgentX | nine ADP1 configs
series.note: 2026-10-15 InferenceX AgentX snapshot; source run 38550677673 attempt 1 (database workflow 2646). Declared image: lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.21-rocm720-mi35x-20261013 (SGLang 0.5.21 / ROCm 7.2.0 image tag; historical runtime payload identity is not independently proven). Compared low-C startup arguments use dsv4_attn_backend=auto and enable_fused_qk_norm_rope=False; monokernel_backend is absent, so its historical state remains UNKNOWN. Current 2026-10-22 reference declares v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x-20261021, flashmla and AMD Monokernel in eight points; C05 disables Monokernel. This line contains only C01-C05/C07-C10, ADP1, aggregated TP2/TP4, FP4; ADP2 and other concurrency points are excluded. X mean interactivity = metrics.mean_intvty (reciprocal API-rounded mean ITL); Y total throughput = metrics.total_tput_tps (input + output across physical GPUs). P90 and per-GPU fields remain separate. Original row IDs, image, dates, source run URL and metrics are retained per point. This historical comparison does not establish Monokernel causality.
